- Split the string by spaces into words; if s is empty or no words, return empty list. Define vowel set (aeiouAEIOU); treat letters not in vowel set as consonants.
- For each word, count consonants by iterating characters and incrementing when char is alphabetic and not a vowel (input guarantees only letters/spaces). Optionally handle uppercase uniformly.
- Collect words whose consonant count equals n in original order and return the resulting list.
